comments.body: Hi! Gentle ping on this one in case it got buried. Happy to adjust anything if needed. Thanks!

Hi @pcbeingused333, thank you for the contribution! I recently introduced a new error type specifically for state handling. https://github.com/supabase/terraform-provider-supabase/pull/426.

We should refactor this solution so that the read function returns a standard `error` similar to https://github.com/supabase/terraform-provider-supabase/blob/bd44c4f365f592a041e61e06addacbb1d7ae27eb/internal/provider/project_resource.go#L337. 

This will allow us to handle state removals and diagnostics in the CRUD methods: https://github.com/supabase/terraform-provider-supabase/blob/bd44c4f365f592a041e61e06addacbb1d7ae27eb/internal/provider/project_resource.go#L206-L216
